headline.caveat: capacity backstop through Apr 2032 (order form of Sep 9, 2025); NVIDIA separately holds an equity stake and bought $2B more stock in Jan 2026 — see nature

realized_to_date.caveat: backstop pays only to the extent capacity goes unsold; amounts drawn to date not disclosed. The Jan 2026 $2B equity purchase did fund.

nature_md: Bundled equity + backstop relationship. (1) **Capacity backstop:** under a Sep 9, 2025 order form (8-K) to their 2023 master services agreement, NVIDIA is obligated to purchase CoreWeave's residual unsold cloud capacity — initial value $6.3B — through April 13, 2032, functioning like a co-signer that lets CoreWeave borrow more, cheaper, against contracted capacity. (2) **Equity:** NVIDIA has been a CoreWeave shareholder since 2023 (~7% at the March 2025 IPO; ~5% per later 13F-era reports), and on Jan 26, 2026 purchased an additional $2B of Class A stock at $87.20/share to accelerate CoreWeave's plan to add >5GW of capacity by 2030 — Bloomberg put NVIDIA's stake at ~13% after that purchase (stake figures vary by source and share class). The vendor is simultaneously supplier, shareholder, and buyer-of-last-resort for the same customer.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: The backstop is a purchase commitment for NVIDIA, disclosed but not a liability unless triggered; if drawn, payments would be prepaid compute/opex. The equity is a balance-sheet investment (fair value). Neither runs through NVIDIA revenue — but both support a customer that generates NVIDIA revenue.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: The backstop underpins CoreWeave's backlog quality and its GPU-collateralized debt structures (~$30B debt); rating agencies and lenders treat NVIDIA's obligation as credit enhancement. The $2B stock sale was equity financing at the parent level.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** the chip vendor guaranteeing its customer's unsold inventory is circularity in its purest form — demand is manufactured at the margin, and CoreWeave's CDS (implying ~50% 5-yr default probability, Jul 2026) shows the market's doubt (Chanos framing). **Bull:** $6.3B against ~$129B of CoreWeave backlog is small; NVIDIA argues it is monetizing otherwise-idle capacity for its own R&D/DGX-cloud needs and that seeding distribution is classic vendor strategy (NVIDIA Nov 2025 IR memo).

events.title: CoreWeave discloses $6.3B NVIDIA capacity backstop through 2032
